header: THE TABLE OF DEGREES: what each one is called and what LEVEL it is (step 58a). My words (26 Oct 2026): "the system does not understand what post graduate means ... we need to teach it all the graduate degrees, that post graduate means a higher degree than graduate, and the list of all the PG degrees". Until then the system knew a flat list of letters (MD, MS, DNB ...) and a pattern for "postgraduate": it listed MBBS doctors for "post graduate degree on medicine". The LEVELS, lowest to highest (when a question says "post graduate", every degree ABOVE graduate counts): certificate school and trade certificates (Class X, Class XII, ITI) diploma a diploma BELOW graduate level (polytechnic engineering, D.Pharm, GNM ...) graduate a bachelor's degree, or a professional degree of the same level (MBBS, BDS, B.Tech, BCA, B.Com, LLB ...) postgraduate a master's degree, or higher than graduate: MD, MS, DNB, MDS, M.Tech, MCA, MBA, M.Sc, LLM ... and every POST-graduate diploma (DGO, DPM, PGDM, PGDCA ...) superspecialty above MD / MS: DM, MCh, DrNB, FNB doctorate PhD, DSc, D.Litt ... Note: an MD is a POSTGRADUATE degree although it is called "Doctor of Medicine"; a doctorate is a PhD-type degree. HOW TO EDIT: one line per degree, d(abbreviation, full name, level, segment, [other ways it is written], "what to confirm", "a note"). The abbreviation, the full name and every other spelling are matched without dots, spaces or capitals ("M.B.B.S." = "mbbs"). A line with a `confirm` text is one the author was NOT sure of: it is listed at the top of docs/QUALIFICATION_LEVELS.md for me to confirm; a line with a `note` only explains. qualifications.selftest.ts checks the table (no spelling twice, every level and segment valid) and that docs/QUALIFICATION_LEVELS.md lists every line; regenerate it with `npx tsx scripts/make-qualification-reference.ts > docs/QUALIFICATION_LEVELS.md`. The list comes from general knowledge of Indian degrees: it has NOT been checked against an official source.
